title: Compatible stage cokernels of an injective coefficient replacement
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preordered set and $D:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Sch}$ a diagram of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Let $F_i$ be abelian sheaves on the small étale site of $D_i$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. For $f:i\to j$ write $u_f=D(f^{\mathrm{op}}):D_j\to D_i$, and suppose given $\varphi_f:u_f^{-1}F_i\to F_j$, where inverse image is as in [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Assume $\varphi_{\mathrm{id}}$ is the canonical inverse-image identity comparison, including transport along $D(\mathrm{id})=\mathrm{id}$. Assume $\varphi_{g\circ f}=\varphi_g\circ u_g^{-1}(\varphi_f)\circ c_{u_g,u_f}$, with transport along $D(g\circ f)=u_f\circ u_g$, where $c$ identifies inverse image along a composite with iterated inverse image. There exist compatible systems $A_i,R_i$ with transitions $\psi_f,\varphi_{R,f}$ satisfying the same canonical identity and composition laws, and maps $a_i:F_i\to A_i$, $b_i:A_i\to R_i$. Every $A_i$ is injective and $0\to F_i\xrightarrow{a_i}A_i\xrightarrow{b_i}R_i\to0$ is short exact [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence]. The maps satisfy $a_j\varphi_f=\psi_fu_f^{-1}(a_i)$ and $b_j\psi_f=\varphi_{R,f}u_f^{-1}(b_i)$. No cone or functor-category diagram is asserted.

source.place: Product/direct-image system construction in the proof of Tag 0EXZ, with exact inverse image and stage cokernels from Tag 04JC; the compatible stage cokernels of an injective coefficient replacement portion of the parent stage-diagram proof.

proof.text: Obtain a compatible injective embedding system a_i. Put R_i=cokernel(a_i) and b_i=cokernel projection. Define the quotient transition using PreservesCokernel.iso for inverse image, followed by cokernel.map for the commuting embedding square. The cokernel projection equation gives compatibility.

Cancel the epic inverse image of b_i to prove quotient identity and composition. Substitute quotient compatibility; naturality of the unit and composition comparisons and the system laws of psi give the required equations.
Each stage is short exact: a_i is mono, cokernel projection is epi, and ShortComplex.exact_of_g_is_cokernel applied to cokernelIsCokernel gives exactness.

lean.statement:
theorem etale_coefficient_injective_cokernel_system
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u})
    (F : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (hidentity : ∀ i : I, φ (𝟙 i) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (D.map_id (op i)))).hom.app
        (F i) ≫ (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.obj (op i))).hom.app (F i))
    (hcomposition : ∀ (i j k : I) (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k),
      φ (f ≫ g) =
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op) (D.map f.op)
          (D.map (f ≫ g).op) (D.map_comp g.op f.op)).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op)).map (φ f) ≫ φ g)
 :
    ∃ (FR : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (φR : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).obj (FR i) ⟶ FR j)
    (hidentityR : ∀ i : I, φR (𝟙 i) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (D.map_id (op i)))).hom.app
        (FR i) ≫ (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.obj (op i))).hom.app (FR i))
    (hcompositionR : ∀ (i j k : I) (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k),
      φR (f ≫ g) =
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op) (D.map f.op)
          (D.map (f ≫ g).op) (D.map_comp g.op f.op)).hom.app (FR i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op)).map (φR f) ≫ φR g)
    (FI : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (ψ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).obj (FI i) ⟶ FI j)
    (hidentityI : ∀ i : I, ψ (𝟙 i) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (D.map_id (op i)))).hom.app
        (FI i) ≫ (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.obj (op i))).hom.app (FI i))
    (hcompositionI : ∀ (i j k : I) (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k),
      ψ (f ≫ g) =
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op) (D.map f.op)
          (D.map (f ≫ g).op) (D.map_comp g.op f.op)).hom.app (FI i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op)).map (ψ f) ≫ ψ g)
    (ai : ∀ i : I, F i ⟶ FI i) (bi : ∀ i : I, FI i ⟶ FR i)
    (wi : ∀ i : I, ai i ≫ bi i = 0)
    (hi : ∀ i : I, (ShortComplex.mk (ai i) (bi i) (wi i)).ShortExact),
      (∀ i : I, Injective (FI i)) ∧
      (∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j),
        φ f ≫ ai j = (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).map (ai i) ≫ ψ f) ∧
      (∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j),
        ψ f ≫ bi j = (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).map (bi i) ≫ φR f)
